lines.zh: 我扇着翅膀，一顿一顿地飞
lines.en: I flap in little bursts
I fly along the flower bed
The wind pushes me off course

lines.zh: 我在两朵花之间停了一下
lines.en: I pause between two flowers
I fly low over the grass

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扇得很快，很轻
lines.en: My wings beat fast and light

lines.zh: 我绕着浆果丛转了一圈
lines.en: I circle the berry bush

lines.zh: 我顺着一阵风滑了一段
lines.en: I glide a stretch on a gust
I fly in the shade; it's cooler

lines.zh: 我飞到高一点的地方看看
lines.en: I rise a little to look around
I head for that patch of purple
I bob up and down
I slip between the leaves
I fly slowly, searching as I go
I follow another's flight line

lines.zh: 我落到一片叶子上歇脚
lines.en: I settle on a leaf to rest

lines.zh: 我停在花上，翅膀还合着
lines.en: I rest on a flower, wings closed
I probe into the flower's heart

lines.zh: 孔雀蛱蝶的腿上，全是甜浆果的粉。
lines.en: Sweet-berry pollen coats the peacock's legs.
I open and close my wings to bask
Wind passes and I grip the petal

lines.zh: 我的翅膀上是四个眼睛似的斑
lines.en: My wings bear four eye-like spots

lines.zh: 我一动不动，装成一片叶子
lines.en: I hold still, pretending to be a leaf
The nectar here is sweet
My antennae touch the stamen
A bee passes nearby
A leaf above me sways
I'll rest just a moment
You're too big; I daren't move

lines.zh: 你的影子凉下来，我合上翅膀。
lines.en: Your shadow cools, and I close my wings.
You raised a hand; I'm flying
I veer half a turn about you

lines.zh: 你身上有甜浆果的花香。
lines.en: You carry the scent of sweet berry flowers.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一扇，粉尘就掉。
lines.en: One wingbeat and the dust falls.

lines.zh: 你的袖口有一点花蜜味。
lines.en: There is a hint of nectar on your cuff.
You're holding still; good
I flutter up before your eyes

lines.zh: 你看清楚我的花纹了吗
lines.en: Did you see my markings
A corner of my wing is gone

lines.zh: 翅上的眼斑掉了一片粉。
lines.en: A patch of scales is gone from my eyespot.

lines.zh: 我落到地上，又挣扎着起来
lines.en: I fall to the ground and struggle up
My wings are trembling

lines.zh: 我把翅膀合上，贴在叶背。
lines.en: I fold my wings flat against the leaf's back.
I can't fly high now
I rest on a bloom to catch myself

lines.zh: 我翅上的眼斑，像四只眼。
lines.en: The eyespots on my wings look like four eyes.
I don't dare come near again
I crawl slowly back into the flower
That flower's in full bloom
Sweet; I can smell it

lines.zh: 我在浆果丛上学蜜蜂悬停。
lines.en: I hover over the berry bush the way a bee does.
There's nectar on your hand
Let me settle here a moment
This one's bigger than the last
I won't shove; I'll wait my turn
The nectar's deep in the petals
I drink for a long while
Done; I drift away slowly
You nudge me and I tip

lines.zh: 我被你的手带起的风推开
lines.en: The wind of your hand pushes me off

lines.zh: 我撞在花瓣上，掉了一点粉
lines.en: I hit a petal and shed some pollen
I flutter out from your fingers

lines.zh: 我的翅膀擦到你的袖子
lines.en: My wing brushes your sleeve
I drop and hurriedly lift again
The bump sends me spinning
I fly behind your shoulder
I retreat into the flowers
You stepped back too; good
Another comes from the trees
We circle each other in flight
Its eyespots are bigger than mine

lines.zh: 我们一前一后落在同一朵花上
lines.en: We land on the same flower, one after the other

lines.zh: 我们扇着翅膀，互相看着
lines.en: We fan our wings and look at each other
It lifts; I follow

lines.zh: 我们在空中画了两个圈
lines.en: We draw two circles in the air

lines.zh: 它落到叶子上，我落在旁边
lines.en: It settles on a leaf and I land beside it
This flower bed serves two
We bask our wings together
I grip it with my legs
It's too heavy to lift
I land on it to test
This isn't a flower
I fly a full circle round it
Its surface is slick
I push it to the leaf's edge
I can't move it, so I leave it
A little pollen sticks to it
I turn and fly off
Something's coming near my flowers
I rise and change position
I slip behind a leaf
I don't dare settle for a moment
I fly a little higher
Those flowers are mine

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，让自己更大
lines.en: I spread my wings to look bigger

lines.zh: 甜浆果的味道从那边过来。
lines.en: The smell of sweet berries comes from that way.
If it moves, I fly
I haven't finished this bloom

lines.zh: 我绕着花丛飞，不敢落下
lines.en: I circle the bed, not daring to land
A raised hand and I climb
I hide against a leaf's underside
I don't dare fly far

lines.zh: 我的翅膀已经有点累了
lines.en: My wings are tiring

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的眼斑，正对着你。
lines.en: The eyespots on my wings face you.

lines.zh: 我落在最高的那朵花上
lines.en: I settle on the highest bloom
It can't reach me here
I glance back once

lines.zh: 甜浆果丛边，我的翅最亮。
lines.en: By the sweet berry bush my wings are brightest.
I beat its fingers with my wings
That was soft and strengthless
I ram it and bounce back
It swats and I tumble half a turn

lines.zh: 我落到它手背上啄了一下
lines.en: I land on its hand and peck

lines.zh: 这一下我用了全部力气
lines.en: I put everything into that
It doesn't move, so I fly off
I circle its head

lines.zh: 它抬手挡，我从下面过去
lines.en: It blocks high; I go low
I retreat to the flower again
A butterfly lifts from the bed

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一开，四个眼斑
lines.en: My wings open with four eyespots
I come out of the shade
The flowers here have just opened
I settle on the tallest bloom
The wind bends my path

lines.zh: 我先绕着这一片飞了一圈
lines.en: I make one circuit of the bed first
Sunlight catches my wings
Good spot; neither sun nor shade
I pause, then lift off

lines.zh: 火苗舔到翅边，眼斑焦了。
lines.en: The flame licks my wing edge and my eyespots scorch.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摔在草上
lines.en: I drop from high and hit the grass

lines.zh: 水沾住我的翅膀，我飞不起来
lines.en: Water glues my wings and I can't fly
The blast blows me far
An arrow grazes my wing's edge

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的翅膀发麻
lines.en: That force numbs my wings
Every flower here has faded

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我吓得落进草丛
lines.en: A flash of lightning drops me into the grass
No flowers below, and no wind
